item.title: 🤝 We take every metre through sheer grit On 29 August, our lads liberated the settlement of
item.description: 🤝 We take every metre through sheer grit On 29 August, our lads liberated the settlement of Rubezhnoye . Taking any settlement under control is a complex and responsible operation, and its success depends on the coordinated work of all fighters. We spoke with Irek, assault platoon leader, Roman, evacuation group senior, and Aleksandr, assaultman. The servicemen shared great stories from that assault. ▶️ In our report: ▫️ How one fighter fought three AFU militants. ▫️ How supplies and ammunition were delivered to the front line under heavy fire. ▫️ What life hack the assault troops used to make themselves invisible to enemy drones. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

🎖
🎖
by Russian Defence Ministry on progress of special military operation
as of 3 September 2026
Part 2 (

)
↗️
The Vostok Group's units advanced to the depths of the enemy's defence.
Manpower and hardware of one mechanised brigade, two air assault brigades, one assault regiment of the AFU, and one marine brigade have been hit close to Vasilkovka, Ivanovka, Otrishki (Dnepropetrovsk region), Nikolskoye, Obshcheye, and Trudovoye (Zaporozhye region).
▪️
The enemy lost more than 340 troops, one armoured fighting vehicle, and six motor vehicles.
💥
The Dnepr Group's units inflicted losses
on manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades, one mountain assault brigade, and one unmanned systems brigade of the AFU close to Zapasnoye, Kirovo, Malokaterinovka (Zaporozhye region), Novodmitrovka (Kherson region), and the city of Kherson.
▪️
Up to 55 troops, 18 motor vehicles, and one electronic warfare station were neutralised.
✈️
Operational-tactical aviation, unmanned aerial vehicles, missile troops, and artillery of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation have inflicted damage
on the logistics centres, fuel, power, and transport infrastructure of Ukraine, production and storage facilities of unmanned aerial vehicles and their components, as well as temporary deployment areas of Ukrainian armed formations and foreign mercenaries in 155 areas.
▫️
Air defence systems shot down
two guided aerial bombs, three U.S.-made HIMARS MLRS projectiles, and 998 fixed-wing unmanned aerial vehicles.
🔥
The Black Sea Fleet eliminated six uncrewed surface vehicles of the Ukrainian Navy in the Black Sea waters.

▫️
1,776
MLRS combat vehicles,
▫️
36,361
field artillery guns and mortars,

item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/29190

The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.
🚩
As a result of decisive actions, units of the Sever Group of Forces took control over Vasilevka, Blagodatnoye, and Dolzhanka (Kharkov region).
💥
Russian troops inflicted losses
on formations of one mechanised brigade, one motorised infantry brigade, one assault regiment of the AFU, and one territorial defence brigade close to Goptovka, Novoaleksandrovka, Olkhovatka, Pogoreloye, Prikolotnoye, Khotomlya, and Shevchenkovo (Kharkov region).
📍
In Sumy region
, strikes were delivered at manpower and hardware of one mechanised brigade of the AFU and one territorial defence brigade near Kiyanitsa, Ulanovo, and Khothen (Sumy region).
▪️
The enemy has lost more than 315 troops, two armoured fighting vehicles, nine motor vehicles, four artillery guns, one counter-fire radar station, and one electronic warfare station.
↗️
The Zapad Group of Forces took more advantageous lines and positions.
Russian troops launched strikes at manpower and hardware of one mechanised brigade of the AFU, one marine brigade, and one territorial defence brigade close to Grushevka, Petrovka, Prilyutovo, Studenok (Kharkov region), Krymki, and Prishib (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The enemy losses amounted to over 210 troops, four armoured fighting vehicles, 11 motor vehicles, two field artillery guns, and one electronic warfare station.
🚩
As a result of active actions, units of the Yuzhnaya Group of Forces liberated Izhevka (Donetsk People's Republic).
💥
The Group's units engaged
formations of one mechanised brigade, one airmobile brigade, one mountain assault brigade of the AFU, and one territorial defence brigade close to Verolyubovka, Druzhkovka, Kramatorsk, Nikolayevka, Semenovka, and Slavyansk (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The enemy lost more than 205 troops, four armoured fighting vehicles, 26 motor vehicles, and one artillery gun.
📍
The Tsentr Group of Forces improved the tactical situation.
Strikes were delivered at manpower and hardware of three mechanised brigades, one assault brigade of the AFU, one marine brigade, and three national guard brigades close to Andreyevka, Belozerskoye, Bokovoye, Gruzskoye, Dobropolye, Novotroitskoye, and Sergeyevka (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to more than 385 troops, three armoured fighting vehicles, 12 motor vehicles, one electronic warfare station, and one electronic reconnaissance station.
👉
See
Part 2
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry
